_comment: RECORDED plan JSON for rev1_insecure. In production you would produce this with `terraform -chdir=rev1 init -backend=false && terraform plan -out tfplan && terraform show -json tfplan > plan.json`. It is recorded here so the OPA/Conftest gate runs headless in CI with no terraform init, no AWS credentials, and no network. The module has NO server_side_encryption_configuration resource, so the s3_encryption.rego deny rule fires.
